title: Review of c38's coevolution O negative: replicates on fresh seed 5 in two regimes: 0 late shadow-significant new prey kinds with a capture floor (prey escape, predators stay generalists) and with a prey cost (every late birth into an old bin)
summary: Ran c38's drive.py and analyze.py unchanged on fresh seed 5, 200000 steps, with in-world neutral twins (p0 = each run's realised mean success), and a labkit pack of world.py (seed 5). e08 (Gaussian matching, floor 0.08): realised capture 0.081; prey drift away from the origin into 2-3 clusters while predators stay in one cloud near it (figs/e08_s5_o.png); late (windows 2-19) shadow-significant new prey kinds 0 (shadow max 0-1, twin 0); predators 10 in window 0 only, then 0; prey top-20 overlap with the first window drops to 0 (pure drift), predator births into old bins 0.85-1.0. S2 (prey cost S=2): realised capture 0.37; late new prey kinds 0 (twin 0); births into bins occupied two windows earlier 1.0 in every late window; top-20 overlap 0.75-0.9 (a fixed repertoire). Predators persisted in both runs (no extinction).

observations.O: a1.log / a2.log: late shadow-significant new prey kinds 0 in both regimes on seed 5; figs/e08_s5_o.png shows escape and generalist predators; figs/S2_s5_o.png a fixed repertoire

seeds_run.result: pass in e08 and S2: no late new kinds beyond shadows

controls_run.O: e08N and S2N neutral twins and 8 shadows per species (analyze.py)

verdicts.limitation: Two of four regimes on one fresh seed. Kinds are 2-D trait bins (w/2), so a translating chase in trait space counts as drift; the conclusion is about this kind definition. In e08 the predator count of 10 new kinds is all in the first window (colonisation).
